title: U.S. passport name change
facts: The procedure to change a name on a U.S. passport depends on factors including how long ago the passport was issued and whether the name change can be documented.
Some qualifying changes within one year of passport issuance can use Form DS-5504 without the ordinary passport application fee, subject to current State Department rules.
Other name changes may require a renewal or new passport application and applicable fees.
Airline reservations for international travel should match the travel document used for the trip.
